Paragraph: "See this figuration of these forests enriched with these flowers, Soumitri! Outpouring is the flower rain, like the rain from rain-clouds...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Trees raining down flowers freely in the forest.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama admires the abundant, unconditional showering of flowers by the forest trees.
Outcome/Resolution: He finds a moment of wonder in nature's generosity.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Unconditional Grace (Dāna/Generosity as depicted by nature)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The raining flowers symbolize spiritual teachers who shower wisdom unconditionally upon all, without expecting anything in return.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Experiencing moments of awe in nature helps soften personal psychological suffering by shifting focus to universal beauty.
